title: Странное настроение Шефа  (The Chef's Strange Mood)

segments.t: In the staff corridor, Senya and Fedya trade guesses about what was said the night before, right until Chef Barinov storms past yelling at them to get back to work. Fedya declares he is tired of guessing what is wrong with the Chef and decides he is simply crazy.
Я не понял, девочки, вы что, на гособеспечении?
Я уже задолбался угадывать, что с ним.
Давай примем, что он просто псих.
Alright, let's go through it step by step in English.
'Did you tell her yesterday?' Senya addresses the listener with the informal singular 'you' alongside 'to say'.
'I told her...' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'I' before landing on 'to say'.
'Sun. Transformer.' Senya brings out the contrast between 'sun' and 'transformer' in a few short words. Fedya answers right away.
'Wait, what did he even say?' The meaning hinges on 'and' working together with 'said' in spoken Russian.
'Oh, what a guy.' Notice how Russian expresses 'oh' and 'Churchill' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'Something about love, probably.' Fedya anchors the line on 'somehow', while 'probably' completes the thought. Senya answers right away.
Я не понял, девочки, вы что, на гособеспечении?
'I do not get it, girls, are you on state welfare or what?' In Russian, the idea of 'I' flows naturally into 'state support' without extra filler words.
'Get to work fast, you stumps!' Fedya brings out the contrast between 'quickly' and 'to work' in a few short words.
'What is wrong with him today?' Notice how Russian expresses 'and' and 'him' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Fedya answers right away.
Я уже задолбался угадывать, что с ним.
'I am sick and tired of guessing what is wrong with him.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'I' and finishing on 'him'.
Давай примем, что он просто псих.
'Let us just accept that he is simply nuts.' Senya brings out the contrast between 'let's' and 'to receive' in a few short words.
'Go knock on your own head.' The meaning hinges on 'the head' working together with 'to knock' in spoken Russian. Alright, let's listen to all those lines again from the top.
Я не понял, девочки, вы что, на гособеспечении?
Я уже задолбался угадывать, что с ним.
Давай примем, что он просто псих.
